title: Time of Choice
next_chapter_hook: "The moment Chen Ji refused, the fragmented Tianji Record suddenly burst forth with light beyond anything before—an ultimate form even Mo Xiansheng had never foreseen. A storm that would shatter the three-thousand-year chess game was about to begin from this moment."

text.content: "The golden rift hung in the heavens, as if Heaven's own eyes opened at this moment, scrutinizing this game that could overturn the eons. Chen Ji stood in the ruins, his robes billowing in the wind, yet his spiritual pressure was crushed to near-asphyxiation by the pressure emanating from the rift. Cang Yutian's proposition still echoed in his ears—to become the Heaven's Successor, to unify all under heaven, this seemed like the ultimate归宿 that all cultivators dreamed of."

dialogue.content: "(Silence for a long while, countless thoughts churning in his heart: If I become the master of heaven, I can protect everyone, find Chen Nian, and spare Su Qingyao from enduring calamities for my sake... But if I become a puppet, what's the difference between this world and one controlled by Heaven's Eye?)'

"(A majestic voice echoed from the golden rift, like the whispers of ancient gods) Chen Ji, I know your doubts. However, becoming the successor is not slavery, but an opportunity for Immortal longevity and unity with the Dao. For a thousand years, only you possess this qualification—the Tianji Record chose you, and that is proof."

text.content: "At this moment, a warm bloodline power pierced through the void, flooding into Chen Ji's heart. That was Su Qingyao's unique Cold Jade bloodline aura, cold yet resolute—she was saying: I trust you, whatever choice you make, I stand behind you."

dialogue.content: "(A faint smile at the corner of his lips, raising his head to stare directly at the golden rift) Heaven's Eye, you have calculated all under heaven, yet ultimately you cannot calculate the human heart. If I accept your proposal, I would be destroying the original intention I spent a thousand years guarding—do you think I would be that foolish?"

text.content: "Cang Yutian was slightly stunned; the avatar condensed from Heaven's Will actually displayed a hint of confusion. He had witnessed countless geniuses bow before power, seen heroes submit to the temptation of immortality, yet never had he seen someone refuse Heaven's own invitation so cleanly."

dialogue.content: "(The pressure suddenly doubled, lightning and thunder raging within the golden rift) Chen Ji, do you truly believe that your incomplete Tianji Record can oppose Heaven? I give you one last chance—accept, or be destroyed."

"(Laughing wildly, the laughter carrying a hint of madness) Destruction? Listen well, Heaven's Eye—I, Chen Ji, want neither your succession nor so-called Immortal longevity. I will take the fourth path: shatter your chessboard, overturn this Heaven!"

text.content: "The moment these words fell, the heavens and earth lost their color. The fragmented Tianji Record floated above Chen Ji's head on its own, ancient pages rustling as if responding to its master's vow. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul manifested its true form for the first time, white hair like snow, aged features yet piercing gaze."

dialogue.content: "(Mo Xiansheng nodded slightly, his voice ancient and desolate) Good, good, indeed shatter the chessboard! What Chen Xuan could not say a thousand years ago, you have completed today. Remember, the true Tianji Record lies not in foresight, but in—rewriting destiny!"

"(A cold harrumph echoed from the golden rift, pressure crushing down like substance) Insolence! Since you insist on this path of death, so be it! From this day forth, you are Heaven's marked target—within the three realms, no one can save you!"

choice.prompt: "Facing the world-destroying pressure and declaration of assassination from Heaven's Eye, Chen Ji needed to make a crucial decision—whether to directly withstand this apocalyptic pressure, or find a breakthrough method by taking another path?"

choices.text: "Withstand the pressure using the Tianji Record"
choices.description: "Burn all Heavenly Fate Value, using the power of the Tianji Record Fragment to block Heaven's Eye's first attack, buying time for Su Qingyao and others to retreat."
choices.visible_reward: "Su Qingyao and others gain opportunity to retreat"
choices.risk_hint: "When Heavenly Fate reaches zero, one will fall into extreme weakness"

text.content: "Chen Ji frantically activated the Tianji Record, its ancient pages blooming with radiance that belonged to no world. Heavenly Fate Value flowed away like water, each point as painful as a knife cut, yet his spine stood straighter than ever—he wanted Su Qingyao to see that he was worthy of her trust."

dialogue.content: "(A startled cry from Su Qingyao in the distance) Chen Ji! You fool!"

choices.description: "Use biting words to provoke Heaven's Eye, and while it rages, secretly guide the threads of destiny, buying time for the true breakthrough method to brew."

dialogue.content: "(A mocking smile at the corner of his lips) Heaven's Eye? Are you certain you're the master of the chessboard, rather than a piece in a larger game? Three thousand years of planning yet failing to calculate a waste's heart—are you certain your eyes aren't blind?"

text.content: "Pressure within the golden rift surged violently; clearly Heaven's Eye was utterly provoked. Meanwhile, Chen Ji secretly guided the Tianji Record's calculations—he was waiting for that moment, the turning point that could flip the board."

choices.description: "Attempt to awaken the forbidden power sleeping within the Chen family's bloodline, an ancient inheritance even Heaven's Eye fears—the cost is potential loss of control."

text.content: "Chen Ji frantically circulated the Chen family bloodline, an ancient power he himself had never sensed awakening within his body. It was an existence beyond Heaven's comprehension—the cost of this forbidden power was the erosion of reason, but at this moment, he had no choice."

dialogue.content: "(Power raging within, eyes gradually染上 blood-red) Chen Nian, wait... Brother will come find you..."

text.content: "The moment Chen Ji made his choice, the Feather Pen of the Fate Writer appeared silently in the void. Countless golden threads extended from its tip, attempting to weave new threads of fate—yet the moment those threads touched Chen Ji, they shattered and dissipated one after another, as if even fate itself could not bind this man determined to rewrite the script."

dialogue.content: "(Heaven's Eye's voice carried a trace of imperceptible fear) You... you are rewriting causality? This power... should not exist in this world!"

text.content: "Cang Yutian announced the official start of the chess game; countless representatives of various powers appeared as phantoms in the void. They witnessed Chen Ji's world-shaking refusal of Heaven, and also witnessed the strange scene of fate threads breaking—after today, the entire cultivation world would know: the废物 disciple of Tianqing Sect intended to play against heaven."

dialogue.content: "(Su Qingyao transmitted resolute intention through the bloodline) Whatever you intend to do, I will accompany you. If this world cannot accommodate you, I will overturn it with you."
"(Feeling the warmth transmitted through the bloodline, a genuine smile appeared on Chen Ji's face) Qingyao, I owe you too much in this life. When this is over, Chen Ji's life belongs to you."

choice.prompt: "Before all witnesses, Chen Ji needed to declare his stance—this declaration would determine the subsequent direction of the world's trends."

choices.description: "Officially declare a break from Heaven, call upon all forces oppressed by Heaven to join, establishing a new order."
choices.visible_reward: "Gain support from rebel forces, reputation greatly increased"
choices.risk_hint: "Revealing strength too early will bring siege from various powers"

dialogue.content: "(Gazing around, voice resonating through heaven and earth) Heaven treats all things as worthless offerings; all of you are either pieces manipulated by it, or accomplices willingly serving as wolves. Today I, Chen Ji, stand forward, not to claim kingship, but to tell the world—destiny lies in one's own hands! Those willing to follow me, let us face this calamity together!"

text.content: "The voice fell, and figures in the distance stirred. The Demonic Path's Saintess Ye Qing's lips curved into an amused smile—she had waited for this moment for far too long."

choices.description: "Do not publicly break from Heaven, preserve current identity, secretly contact rebel forces, wait for the right moment to act."
choices.visible_cost: "Must continue pretending to be a废物"
choices.visible_reward: "Maintain strategic secrecy, more time for planning"
choices.risk_hint: "Su Qingyao may fall into danger due to lack of knowledge"

dialogue.content: "(Lowering his voice, only perceivable by Su Qingyao) Today's events, Heaven's Eye will certainly remember. But frontal confrontation is not the best strategy; I need time. Within three years, I will make this world change masters—before then, I must trouble you to continue being my enemy."

text.content: "Su Qingyao perceived Chen Ji's true intentions through the bloodline, and that tacit understanding made her nod slightly. On the surface, she was the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of Tianqing Sect leaving in anger after discovering the废物 disciple's abnormality; in truth, she had resolved to protect this man's secret no matter what."

"Just as everyone thought everything was settled, the fragmented Tianji Record suddenly began to shake violently. Ancient pages turned on their own without anyone's activation, stopping at the final page—the area that had been blank for a thousand years was now filled with densely-packed golden text visible to the naked eye."

dialogue.content: "(Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul revealed shock for the first time) This... this is the awakening of the Tianji Record's ultimate form! Impossible, even Chen Xuan never triggered such a state—who exactly are you?"

"(Staring at the text appearing on the Tianji Record, Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply) This is impossible... This content, I have never seen it before. It is telling me—the true purpose of the Tianji Record is not foresight, nor scheming, but... (The voice abruptly stopped, as if seeing something unspeakable)"

text.content: "Heaven's Eye within the golden rift suddenly contracted violently, as if perceiving some existence beyond its comprehension awakening. That pressure maintained since ancient times showed its first tremor—not weakening, but fear."

dialogue.content: "(Heaven's Eye's voice carried trembling for the first time) Stop! You cannot look at that content! That is... that is forbidden beyond this world! Chen Ji, let us each take a step back—I agree to preserve your independent consciousness, we shall jointly govern Heaven!"

choice.prompt: "The Tianji Record's ultimate form is awakening, Heaven's Eye is showing weakness and seeking peace for the first time—this is a rare opportunity, yet also a greater trap. Chen Ji needed to make a decision in an instant."

choices.description: "Whatever the Tianji Record reveals, I must see it to the end. This is the only chance to break the chessboard; cannot retreat from fear."
choices.visible_reward: "Thoroughly awaken the Tianji Record's ultimate form"
choices.risk_hint: "Unknown content may change Chen Ji's fundamental existence"

dialogue.content: "(Chen Ji gripped the Tianji Record tightly, his gaze firmer than ever) You're afraid? The eternal Heaven is actually afraid! Since that is the case, I must see—what exactly are you hiding!"

text.content: "The golden text on the Tianji Record flooded into Chen Ji's consciousness like a tide, the ultimate truth beyond causality, beyond reincarnation—he saw Heaven's Eye's true origin, and also the fate entanglement between himself and all this."

choices.description: "Heaven's Eye's concession is already an unexpected delight; accept the proposal of jointly governing Heaven, preserve current gains, plan slowly for the future."
choices.visible_cost: "Lose the chance to thoroughly break the chessboard"
choices.visible_reward: "Gain breathing room, temporary peace with Heaven"
choices.risk_hint: "Compromise may give Heaven's Eye time to recover"

dialogue.content: "(After thoughtful pause) Joint governance... is not entirely impossible. But I have three conditions: First, release all imprisoned Heavenly Fate bearers; Second, Chen Nian must return to my side; Third—(a cold smile at the corner of his lips) you must tell me the true origin of the Tianji Record."

text.content: "A strange silence echoed from the golden rift. Heaven's Eye clearly had not expected Chen Ji to maintain such a composed negotiating posture even when holding advantage—this反而 made it even more wary."

choices.description: "The content revealed by the Tianji Record is too significant to bear alone. Let Su Qingyao witness it through the shared destiny method, ensuring that no matter what happens, someone will know the truth."
choices.visible_reward: "Both share Heaven's Fate together, establishing deeper bonds"
choices.risk_hint: "Shared destiny may put Su Qingyao in danger"
choices.process_label: 与苏青瑶共赴终极真相

dialogue.content: "(Calling through the bloodline) Qingyao, come here. I want you to witness this together with me—if this truth will destroy me, at least you must know everything, then complete my unfinished work for me."

text.content: "Su Qingyao did not hesitate, darting over. Her Cold Jade bloodline ignited, resonating with Chen Ji. When both their consciousness simultaneously touched the golden text on the Tianji Record, a power beyond time and space intertwined their fates completely—the shared destiny buff officially activated at this moment."

"The golden text finally stopped flowing, completely presented before Chen Ji and Su Qingyao. It was a record spanning countless eons—the Tianji Record was not created by Heaven. On the contrary, it was a primordial object that existed before Heaven's Eye was even born. Heaven's Eye merely窃取ed part of the Tianji Record's power to rise above all beings, and all generations of Tianji Record holders were objects it sought to erase and utilize."

dialogue.content: "(After reading the final line, Chen Ji laughed uproariously) A fine eternal Heaven! So you are merely a thief! You窃取ed primordial power to establish authority, yet viewed the true Tianji Record holders as threats—laughable, utterly laughable!"

text.content: "Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul finally消散 completely upon hearing this truth, dissolving into starlight that merged into the Tianji Record. At his final moment, he completed his thousand-year duty as guardian, delivering all truths to Chen Ji. And Chen Nian in the depths of the Holy Sect suddenly sensed a familiar aura—Brother's power, awakening."

"Heaven's Eye within the golden rift completely abandoned pretense, pressure surging to unprecedented levels. Yet Chen Ji at this moment was no longer that废物 who could only survive by predicting the future—the moment the Tianji Record's ultimate form awakened, he gained the qualification to oppose Heaven. The Feather Pen of the Fate Writer appeared in his hand—this time, he would write his own ending on the script Heaven had authored."
